headline: Wardens Rebound in Callahan's Passage as Weathered Expanse Front Erupts
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, the tide has turned sharply across Callahan's Passage, where Warden defenders stamped out the Colonial foothold, restoring Warden control over nine strategic bases while reducing a tenth to neutral rubble amid eight fresh exchanges at Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage that claimed over two thousand casualties in two hours. Heavy combat has concurrently exploded in the Weathered Expanse, logging nine base upheavals in the past two hours and eroding Colonial holdings down to five redoubts against a lone Warden base and three vacant, contested ruins, all at a cost of twenty-one hundred fallen. Along the western approaches, Mooring County remains a meat grinder, consuming over eleven hundred combined casualties in the latest two-hour stretch without fracturing the intact twelve-base Warden perimeter. The tumult has temporarily receded from Palantine Berm, which logged no base transitions this period after earlier friction, while the Stlican Shelf steadied under Colonial command of eight bases to one. Nevish Line similarly saw zero base changes in the last two hours, holding steady at a six-to-two Warden advantage despite continuous skirmishing along the front.
